name: stash-gold-retrieval-v1
notes: Known-item retrieval cases for comparing embedding models. Queries are deliberately PARAPHRASED rather than copied from the fact text: a query that reuses a fact's distinctive wording rewards lexical overlap and would flatter any model, defeating the purpose. relevant_fact_ids is a SET because the corpus contains many near-duplicate consolidated facts — one question is answered correctly by any of them, and demanding a specific row would measure duplicate-lottery luck instead of retrieval quality. Only namespaces that are fully shadow-migrated can be scored on both columns; as of 2026-08-15 that is /projects/tolowa-studio, /tools/baton and /system/healthcheck. Run `stash eval validate` before trusting any score.

cases.query: Does searching memory take into account which model produced a stored vector?
cases.note: The answer is no — which is why a mixed-model corpus degrades silently.

cases.query: Why would the same record be sent to the paid reasoner over and over without ever succeeding?
What did we move the model gateway onto after dropping Cloudflare's inference?
How was the CRM view for records still needing enrichment created?
Can someone looking at the CRM see when and how a company record was enriched?
Which CRM field turned out to be unreliable as a signal that enrichment had finished?
What actually caused the customer relationship system to stop sending mail on our host?
Which release of our self-hosted sales database are we running and where does it live?
What tidy-up produced new rows in the skills registry database?
Which specification framework was deliberately left out when the five-step upgrades shipped?
How much of the build-with-AI-from-scratch approach did we already do under different names?
What is the correct way to push the main marketing website to production?
Was the new page about seeing your business clearly confirmed serving traffic?
Which commit carried the approved page, and was an email drafted alongside it?
Which mailboxes do we use to reach Scott at the hub company?
What makes the pitch land with smaller and mid-sized companies?
What do we actually sell, and which engagement size do we push first?
Which coding principles from a well-known AI researcher did we decide to take on?
What came out of reviewing publicly available frontend and design skills for our pitch work?
Which experimental approach was used to rebuild the bakery concept site?
What mailbox permission scope does the automated mail handler need?
What did we publish publicly about our own tooling?
Why did we decline to adopt the skill that sat behind a paid community, and what did we keep from it?
cases.note: Eight near-identical consolidated facts describe this one decision. A model finding ANY of them has answered correctly — this case exists partly to demonstrate why relevant_fact_ids must be a set.

cases.query: How was the knowledge workspace reorganised at the top level?
How is the window cleaning company classified in our client records?
Did moving pages in bulk break their links, and did anything land in the wrong place?
How does the dispatcher notice when a worker admits it cannot do something?
Which of the routing lanes costs nothing to run, and how much evidence do we have that it works?
Which capability was enforced merely by wording in a prompt instead of structurally?
What mechanism moves substantial work to other tools rather than relying on the assistant to remember to?
